question: In 1938, Congress President Subhash Chandra Bose set up a National Planning Committee. Who was its Chairman?
solution:
The correct answer is** Jawaharlal Nehru.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under **Jawaharlal Nehru**'s leadership, **Subhash Chandra Bose** founded the **National Planning Committee in 1938**.
 
• National Planning Committee
 
 
• The intention of the **National Planning Committee** was to create an **economic strategy** with the **primary objective of guaranteeing an adequate standard of living for the population.**
 
• A fifteen-member National Planning Committee was then established, with the **Committee** emphasizing in a memo that national independence is a crucial precondition for adopting any actions that may be discovered to be required for implementing the plan in all of its varied components.
 
• Near the end of 1938, nine years before independence, the Indian National Congress established a National Planning Committee to emphasize the significance of social and economic goals as well as the necessity of learning from other nations' experiences with planned development through national plans.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad**

 
 
• **​​Abul Kalam Ghulam Muhiyuddin Ahmed** bin **Khairuddin Al-Hussaini Azad **was a senior member of the** Indian National Congress,** an **Islamic theologian**, and a supporter of **Indian independence**. He lived from 11 November 1888 until 22 February 1958.
 
 
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri**​
 
 
• **Indian politician** and **leader Lal Bahadur Shastri **was born on October 2, 1904, and passed away on January 11, 1966. Between 1961 and 1963, he served as India's sixth home minister and as the country's second **prime minister** between 1964 and 1966.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**
 
 
• **Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel,** better known by his stage name **Sardar Patel,** was an Indian lawyer, prominent political figure, and politician who lived from October 31, 1875, to December 15, 1950. From 1947 until 1950, he was India's first deputy prime minister and home minister.
